contracts: Captured date literals and actual typed DateTime parameters only; no numeric, Decimal, Text or conversion-call hint extraction.
Temporal endpoint intersections preserve negative-date order and epoch aliases. Original eager predicates remain mandatory; no partial unsafe AND extraction.
Automatic reads retain source order; required indexes retain key order. Chosen failures propagate, candidate ceilings remain unchanged and partial snapshots never complete a cache.
Binding remains metadata-only. Reused plans retain current exact parameter carriers without canonicalizing stored payloads.
Linked/external wrappers forward constraints unchanged; recomputed views are derived plans; native cached fields retain existing selection refusal.
No dependency, default allowance, write eligibility or native qualification change. Original-file candidate replay remains pending.
